summary: Fleet Telemetry API v1 to v2 moves all endpoints from /v1/... to /v2/... and FleetSnapshot.api_version from "v1" to "v2"; v1 is deprecated and shuts off 2026-12-01. Orientation breaks from Euler degrees orientation.roll/pitch/yaw (intrinsic Z-Y-X) to unit quaternion orientation.qx/qy/qz/qw (Hamilton, scalar last, same R=Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll), q and -q same). Uncertainty breaks from scalar noise (metres 1-sigma) to required 6x6 covariance (row-major, x,y,z then rot X,Y,Z) plus new required health (0..1, alert below 0.5).

endpoints_renamed.notes: All endpoints move from /v1/... to /v2/...; v1 endpoints are deprecated and will be shut off on 2026-12-01.

fields_removed.notes: Removed noise (isotropic 1-sigma position uncertainty, metres). Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. A scalar equivalent of the old noise is sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3).

Removed orientation.pitch (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X) as part of Euler degrees -> unit quaternion change: same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll), Hamilton convention scalar last. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from quaternion directly; if heading needed use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

fields_added.notes: Added covariance: 6x6 symmetric pose covariance as nested row-major arrays. Variable order x, y, z (m) then rotation about X, Y, Z (rad). The position block covariance[0:3][0:3] is in m². Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. A scalar equivalent of the old noise is sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3).

Added required health (0..1): composite localisation/drive health from the on-robot monitor. 1 = nominal; values below 0.5 mean the robot should be serviced. Ops dashboards should raise a health alert below 0.5.

Added unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative.

type_changes.notes: Changed from EulerOrientation (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X) to Quaternion (unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll)). Server does not canonicalise sign. Migration: build rotations from quaternion directly; yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)).
